projects.name: ARETE: End-to-End Hiring & Interview Management System
projects.description:
Export and Import (EXIM Portal): Working on an EXIM Portal focused on the digitalization of SEZ and STPI operations. Responsible for gathering and analyzing business requirements, conducting stakeholder discussions, and documenting user stories, process flows, and functional requirements. Collaborating with UX/UI and development teams to design efficient workflows and user-centric solutions. Ensuring adherence to SEZ regulations, Customs Act requirements, and statutory compliance standards. Supporting the development of audit trails, MIS reporting, and compliance monitoring features to enhance audit readiness, operational visibility, and control. Contributing to risk reduction and data integrity by defining validation rules and governance requirements.
RegIntel: Worked as a Business Analyst on the Regulatory Intelligence (Regintel) platform, a centralized system supporting regulatory content ingestion, triage, review, validation, and auditability. Led requirement gathering and prepared User Requirement Specifications (URS) covering business processes, workflows, roles, access controls, notifications, and reporting. Maintained JIRA boards, created and tracked user stories, defects, and change requests, and ensured timely closure through regular follow-ups. Conducted cross-functional stakeholder meetings, requirement walkthroughs, and impact assessments. Actively participated in Scrum ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. Supported UAT cycles, coordinated issue resolution with development and A teams, and ensured solutions aligned with compliance standards, traceability, and operational efficiency.
ARETE: End-to-End Hiring & Interview Management System
As a Business Analyst, I worked on designing and optimizing an end-to-end hiring lifecycle within a recruitment software application. I collaborated with HR, recruitment, and leadership stakeholders to gather business
requirements and translate them into functional workflows covering job requisition creation and approvals, multi-platform job posting, and candidate application intake. I defined system requirements for resume parsing to auto-create candidate profiles and enabled recruiter-led screening and shortlisting based on configurable skill and eligibility criteria. I supported the integration of online quizzes and Mercer | Mettl assessments to evaluate technical, cognitive, and behavioral competencies, ensuring assessment results were mapped to decision-making dashboards. I helped design interview scheduling, structured feedback capture, and consolidated candidate views to support data-driven hiring decisions. Additionally, I contributed to offer generation, digital communication, background verification, and onboarding workflows, ensuring seamless handoffs across the recruitment lifecycle and improved hiring efficiency
UBER EATS, UBER MAPS - Experienced Business Analyst with over 2+ years at Wipro, driving data-backed decision-making for Uber Technologies across Uber Eats and Maps projects. Proven expertise in gathering and translating business requirements into actionable insights, enhancing product features, and optimizing user experience. Skilled in stakeholder management, process improvement, and performance reporting, with a strong grasp of data tools like SQL, Excel, and internal analytics platforms. Successfully collaborated with cross-functional teams to improve delivery logistics, map accuracy, and platform efficiency
INSURANCE PROJECT - Automate the Insurance Claim processing so that the lead time taken to process a claim is reduced. Reduce manual tasks and paperwork, have a central repository of claim requests which facilitates quicker search and retrieval.
